_comment: First day of each NFL Draft (local date). Used as the PREDICTION CUTOFF for pre-draft features (a feature must be knowable strictly before this date) and as the reference date for age-at-draft. Entered manually from the public record of league-announced draft dates; not fetched programmatically. Cross-checked at runtime against nflverse's independent integer age_at_draft (tests/test_advanced_features.py::test_age_at_draft_consistent_with_nflverse), so a wrong date would surface as an age mismatch.

combine_known_by._comment: The combine is held in late February / early March of the draft year. No per-player test date exists in the source, so combine results are treated as knowable by March 15 of the draft year -- a conservative bound that is still before every draft date above.
